predecessors.name: Principality of Turov and Pinsk
predecessors.text: Pinsk, the semi-independent principality created within Turov after the succession of 1162

successors.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
successors.text: Pinsk, 'incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania' by 1320

ledger.x: 1294: Pinsk appears as its own principality.
By 1320: Pinsk is incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
The principality ends as an independent state and becomes a Gediminid fief of Lithuania.

wars.name: Pinsk against Lithuania
wars.outcome: 'In 1274, Pinsk along with Ruthenian princes and Tatars fought against Lithuania'; 'Afterwards, it was captured by Lithuanian duke Erdvilas, and Pinsk became a fief of Lithuania' and 'By 1320, Pinsk was incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania'.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the Turov-Pinsk frontier and the marsh border with Galicia-Volhynia and Lithuania are approximate.
